english: Let $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&-\sqrt{3}\\\sqrt{3}&1\end{pmatrix}$ and let $A^{2026}=\begin{pmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{pmatrix}$. Then the value of $\dfrac{c}{a}$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&-\sqrt{3}\\\sqrt{3}&1\end{pmatrix}$ है तथा $A^{2026}=\begin{pmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{pmatrix}$ है। तब $\dfrac{c}{a}$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: The map $x+iy\mapsto\begin{pmatrix}x&-y\\y&x\end{pmatrix}$ respects products, so $R_{\theta}$ corresponds to $\cos\theta+i\sin\theta$ and $A$ to $1+i\sqrt3$.
By De Moivre's theorem, $\left(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta\right)^{n}=\cos n\theta+i\sin n\theta$, so $R_{\theta}^{n}=R_{n\theta}$ and $A^{n}=2^{n}R_{n\pi/3}$.

For $n=2026$: $2026=3\cdot675+1$, so $\dfrac{2026\pi}{3}=675\pi+\dfrac{\pi}{3}$. As $675$ is odd, $\cos\left(675\pi+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=-\cos\frac{\pi}{3}=-\frac12$ and $\sin\left(675\pi+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=-\sin\frac{\pi}{3}=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}$.
Hence $\dfrac{c}{a}=\sqrt3=1.7320\ldots$, which is $1.73$ correct to two decimal places.
originality_note: New: the ratio of two entries of A^2026 is asked, so only the angle 2026 pi/3 matters and the large factor 2^2026 cancels (way 5). Closest known: A = [[cos, -sin],[sin, cos]] with A^n = R(n theta) (JEE Main type). Different because: the matrix is a scaled rotation written with surds, and the answer needs the reduction 675 pi + pi/3 with the sign from the odd multiple.
blueprint_concepts: Higher integral powers of a square matrices

concept_use.Higher integral powers of a square matri: The entries of A^2026 are required; they come from A^n = 2^n R_{n pi/3}.
concept_use.De Moivre theorem: A corresponds to 1 + i sqrt3 = 2(cos pi/3 + i sin pi/3), and De Moivre gives the 2026th power.

stem_review: Read as a student: every matrix and symbol is defined before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed with sympy and is unique and equal to the Answer Plan; no hyperbolic functions or asymptotes. Checked: sympy computes A^2026 exactly and c/a = sqrt(3) = 1.7320...; 1.73 is a positive decimal as planned and the rounding is unambiguous. Changed: No change.
key_step: Writing A = 2 R_{pi/3} and reducing 2026 pi/3 modulo 2 pi.
justification: Routine chain: polar form of the matrix, De Moivre, angle reduction with a sign check. Easier than the power-pattern statements of 2026-P1-Q8 (L3); the idea is familiar.
